jobs.title: <![CDATA[Modernize Web Portal UI/UX]]>
jobs.description: I have a functioning web portal that does its job but no longer feels intuitive or visually current. I want to refresh the entire interface so the first impression is modern and clean while also making everyday tasks simpler for users... (Budget: ₹12500 - ₹37500 INR, Jobs: CSS, Figma, Graphic Design, HTML, JavaScript, PHP, UI / User Interface, UX / User Experience, Web Design, Website Design)
jobs.coverLetter:
Dear Unknown Team,

I came across the <![CDATA[Modernize Web Portal UI/UX]]> role at Unknown and it immediately caught my attention. The combination of technologies and the remote-first approach aligns perfectly with how I work best — independently, with ownership, and across the full stack.

I'm a full-stack developer based in Lagos, Nigeria, with hands-on experience in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. In my recent work, I built Waste-management and Dev-profile — projects that required deep problem-solving and attention to user experience. I thrive in environments where I can contribute to both the frontend and backend, and I'm particularly drawn to roles that involve building real products used by real people.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my experience could contribute to Unknown. Thank you for taking the time to review my application.

Best regards,
Ajibade Hassan
